title: Rondale Moore 2023 Panini Prizm Green Arizona Cardinals #7 NFL Football
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: Rondale Moore 2023 Panini Prizm Green Arizona Cardinals #7 NFL trading card featuring the player in the National Football League. This original sports trading card is made of card stock and belongs to the base set of the 2023 Panini Prizm series. It showcases Rondale Moore from the Arizona Cardinals and is a Green Prizm parallel variety. Perfect for football card collectors.
